scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/product-site build && corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/studio-app build && corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/cloud build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/product-site test && corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/studio-app test && corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/cloud test
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/product-site exec tsc --noEmit && corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/studio-app typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/cloud typecheck
scripts.quality: corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/product-site quality && corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/studio-app quality && corepack pnpm --filter @quillframe/cloud quality
scripts.ci: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run test && corepack pnpm run build
